articles.title: Peritoneal ovarian cancer growth in the omentum proceeds independently of mature adipocytes
articles.abstract: Abstract The omentum, a specialized adipose tissue within the peritoneum, is a primary niche of ovarian cancer dissemination. Omental adipocytes are widely thought to promote tumor growth by supplying lipids, supported in part by studies using global FABP4 deficiency. Here, we directly test whether mature adipocytes are required for peritoneal ovarian cancer growth using mice congenitally lacking mature adipocytes within the peritoneal cavity, including the omentum. Across several ovarian cancer models (ID8p53 −/− Brca2 −/− , BPPNM, and KPCA), tumors preferentially seed adipose-associated regions despite the absence of mature adipocytes. Loss of mature adipocytes does not impair peritoneal tumor expansion, whereas removal of the adipocyte-free omentum significantly reduces tumor burden. Murine and human single-cell transcriptomic analyses reveal enrichment of lipid-handling gene expression, including FABP4, in omental endothelial cells at steady state and in tumor-bearing tissue. Endothelial-specific deletion of FABP4 reduces omental tumor expansion and limits tumor vascular complexity. These findings indicate that mature adipocytes are not required for omental ovarian cancer growth and highlight tumor-growth-favoring features of the omental niche endothelium.
articles.title_zh: 腹膜卵巢癌在网膜中的生长独立于成熟脂肪细胞
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 大网膜是腹膜内的一种特殊脂肪组织，是卵巢癌播散的主要场所。人们普遍认为网膜脂肪细胞通过提供脂质来促进肿瘤生长，这在一定程度上得到了利用全球 FABP4 缺陷的研究的支持。在这里，我们使用腹膜腔（包括大网膜）先天性缺乏成熟脂肪细胞的小鼠直接测试腹膜卵巢癌生长是否需要成熟脂肪细胞。在几种卵巢癌模型（ID8p53 −/− Brca2 −/− 、BPPNM 和 KPCA）中，尽管不存在成熟脂肪细胞，肿瘤仍优先种植脂肪相关区域。成熟脂肪细胞的损失不会损害腹膜肿瘤的扩张，而去除无脂肪细胞的网膜可显着减轻肿瘤负荷。小鼠和人类单细胞转录组分析揭示了稳态下的网膜内皮细胞和荷瘤组织中脂质处理基因表达的富集，包括 FABP4。内皮特异性删除 FABP4 可减少网膜肿瘤的扩张并限制肿瘤血管的复杂性。这些发现表明，成熟的脂肪细胞不是大网膜卵巢癌生长所必需的，并强调了大网膜微环境内皮细胞有利于肿瘤生长的特征。

articles.title: Observed poleward heat transport by mesoscale eddies in the deep Southern Ocean
articles.abstract: Abstract Mesoscale eddies in the Southern Ocean extend from the surface to the deep ocean and contribute to regional and global ocean heat budgets. However, sparse in situ observations have limited estimates of eddy meridional heat transport (EMHT) to the near surface, leaving deep-ocean processes poorly understood. Here we quantify deep eddy kinetic energy (EKE) and EMHT using Argo observations. We find that deep EMHT reaches at least the same order of magnitude as surface transport, despite deep EKE being only one-fifth of surface levels. Float observations and sensitivity experiments reveal that, relative to mean-flow transport alone, deep EMHT extends the meridional movement of subtropical warm waters towards Antarctica by over ten degrees of latitude. About 60% of this deep transport originates from the Indian Ocean sector. These findings provide observational evidence that mesoscale eddies can modulate deep Southern Ocean heat redistribution, with potential implications for Antarctic climate.
articles.title_zh: 观测到的南大洋深处中尺度涡流向极地的热传输
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 南大洋的中尺度涡旋从海面延伸到深海，对区域和全球海洋热量收支做出贡献。然而，稀疏的现场观测限制了对近地表涡经向热传输（EMHT）的估计，导致人们对深海过程知之甚少。在这里，我们使用 Argo 观测来量化深涡动能 (EKE) 和 EMHT。我们发现，尽管深层 EKE 只有表面水平的五分之一，但深层 EMHT 至少达到了与表面传输相同的数量级。浮标观测和敏感性实验表明，相对于单独的平均流量输送，深层EMHT将副热带暖水向南极洲的经向运动延伸了十多个纬度。大约 60% 的深层运输源自印度洋区域。这些发现提供了观测证据，表明中尺度涡流可以调节南大洋深处的热量重新分布，对南极气候具有潜在影响。

articles.title:
Design and Demonstration
of a Direct Air Capture System
with Moisture-Driven CO2 Delivery into Aqueous Medium
articles.abstract: Abstract Two direct air capture (DAC) systems were designed and demonstrated to passively capture CO2 from ambient air and use moisture to release the CO2 into an alkaline medium. A bench-scale system delivering ∼1 g CO2 d–1 was demonstrated in a laminar flow hood, and a small pilot-scale system that could deliver ∼100 g CO2 d–1 was operated outdoors in a 4.2 m2 raceway pond. Novel elongated mesh-tube packets containing anion-exchange resin (AER) beads were found to reduce drying and CO2 loading time 4.3-fold compared to larger mesh bags. Technoeconomic analysis (TEA) estimates the cost of capturing CO2 into an alkaline solution, suitable for cultivating photosynthetic microorganisms, to be $229 per tonne for a practical scenario based on current results and $72 per tonne for an aspirational scenario considering improvements to sorbent capacity, hydrophobicity, and sorbent lifetime. TEA further estimates an additional $110 per tonne to extract CO2 from solution, purify it, and compress it to 15 MPa, suitable for sequestration. Moisture-driven processes have the potential to use up to 87% less energy than thermal and/or vacuum swing DAC by using energy from water evaporation.
articles.title_zh:
设计与演示
直接空气捕获系统
将水分驱动的 CO2 输送到水性介质中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 设计并演示了两种直接空气捕获 (DAC) 系统，可从环境空气中被动捕获 CO2，并利用水分将 CO2 释放到碱性介质中。在层流罩中演示了可提供约 1 g CO2 d–1 的实验室规模系统，并在室外 4.2 m2 跑道池中运行了可提供约 100 g CO2 d–1 的小型中试规模系统。研究发现，与较大的网袋相比，含有阴离子交换树脂 (AER) 珠的新型细长网管包可将干燥和 CO2 装载时间缩短 4.3 倍。技术经济分析 (TEA) 估计，根据目前的结果，将 CO2 捕获到适合培养光合微生物的碱性溶液中的成本为每吨 229 美元，考虑到吸附剂容量、疏水性和吸附剂寿命的改进，理想情况下的成本为每吨 72 美元。 TEA 进一步估计每吨额外花费 110 美元，用于从溶液中提取二氧化碳、净化二氧化碳并将其压缩至适合封存的 15 MPa。通过利用水蒸发的能量，湿气驱动工艺的能耗比热和/或真空摆动 DAC 的能耗可减少高达 87%。

articles.title:
30-Year
Greenhouse Gas Changes in Megacities Driven
by Emission Reduction Policies: A Case Study of Beijing
articles.abstract: Abstract This study investigates the spatiotemporal dynamics of urban greenhouse gases amidst energy transition, aiming to assess the emission reduction effectiveness of Beijing’s “coal-to-gas” and “coal-to-electricity” policies and to pinpoint the key sources arising from the subsequent structural shifts in the emission profile. We analyzed greenhouse gas concentrations from 1993 to 2024 using gas chromatography. Vertical profile data across the 8–240 m atmospheric layer from 2022 to 2024 were obtained using a pod-based measurement system installed on a 325-m meteorological tower. The results show that the CO2 growth rate initially increased and then decreased during the 1993–2024 period, and the difference in CO2 concentration between the ground and upper air decreased by 20–56% compared to the historical maxima. These trends demonstrate that the energy transition has effectively mitigated the increase in CO2 concentration. A concurrent deceleration in the growth rates of CH4 and N2O was also observed, albeit with less pronounced changes in their vertical gradients. This mitigation is largely linked to the shift from landfill disposal to waste incineration and the promotion of new energy vehicles. In contrast, SF6 emissions increased steadily from 2008 to 2024, primarily driven by growing electricity demand and the expansion of the semiconductor industry. The recent eight-year average growth rate reached 0.52 ppt yr–1. These findings underscore the power and semiconductor sectors as critical domains for targeted SF6 emission control.
articles.title_zh:
30年
特大城市驱动的温室气体变化
减排政策：以北京为例
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究探讨能源转型过程中城市温室气体时空动态，旨在评估北京“煤改气”和“煤改电”政策的减排效果，并找出后续排放结构变化的关键来源。我们使用气相色谱分析了 1993 年至 2024 年的温室气体浓度。使用安装在 325 米气象塔上的基于吊舱的测量系统获得了 2022 年至 2024 年跨越 8-240 米大气层的垂直剖面数据。结果表明，1993—2024年期间CO2增长率先增后减，地面和高空CO2浓度差较历史最大值缩小了20%～56%。这些趋势表明，能源转型有效减缓了二氧化碳浓度的增加。还观察到 CH4 和 N2O 的生长速率同时减速，尽管它们的垂直梯度变化不太明显。这种缓解很大程度上与垃圾填埋处理向垃圾焚烧的转变以及新能源汽车的推广有关。相比之下，从 2008 年到 2024 年，SF6 排放量稳步增加，这主要是由于电力需求的增长和半导体行业的扩张。最近八年平均增长率达到0.52 ppt yr–1。这些发现强调电力和半导体行业是有针对性的 SF6 排放控制的关键领域。

articles.title:
Nanoscale Formation,
Structure, and Stability of Phosphate-Iron
Colloids at Anoxic-Oxic Interfaces
articles.abstract: Abstract The mobility of phosphorus (P) at anoxic–oxic interfaces is largely controlled by the formation of phosphate-iron (Fe) colloids, yet the nanoscale mechanisms underlying their formation, structure, and stability remain poorly described. Here, we systematically investigate these processes across a range of environmentally relevant conditions. Under anoxic conditions, phosphate-Fe(II) complexes exist predominantly as truly dissolved species. Upon transition into oxic conditions, phosphate-Fe(III) colloids form as a function of Fe/P molar ratio. At lower Fe/P ratios (e.g., ≤3), stable nanosized colloids (20–100 nm) form, whereas higher ratios (e.g., >3) promote aggregation into larger particles (>1000 nm) under the conditions tested. Structural analyses reveal that colloidal formation arises from a phosphate-stabilized, short-range ordered ferrihydrite phase, where phosphate inhibits Fe polymerization via corner-sharing Fe–O–P bonds and enhances electrostatic stabilization through surface enrichment. Natural organic matter (NOM, 2.5 and 10 mg C/L) promotes colloid generation under anoxic conditions and enhances stability at higher Fe/P ratios through electrostatic and steric interactions. Stability assessments in the tested water matrices show matrix-dependent persistence, with 0–41% of the colloids remaining suspended after 28 days without NOM, and substantially enhanced colloidal suspension (61–95%) in the NOM-amended system. This work provides mechanistic insight into one important pathway that may contribute to P mobility under redox-transition conditions.
articles.title_zh:
纳米级形成，
磷酸铁的结构和稳定性
缺氧-好氧界面处的胶体
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 磷（P）在缺氧-有氧界面的迁移率很大程度上受磷酸盐-铁（Fe）胶体形成的控制，但其形成、结构和稳定性的纳米级机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们系统地研究了一系列环境相关条件下的这些过程。在缺氧条件下，磷酸盐-Fe(II) 络合物主要以真正溶解的物质形式存在。转变为有氧条件后，磷酸盐-Fe(III) 胶体的形成与 Fe/P 摩尔比有关。在较低的 Fe/P 比率（例如，≤3）下，形成稳定的纳米级胶体（20-100 nm），而较高的比率（例如，> 3）则在测试条件下促进聚集成更大的颗粒（> 1000 nm）。结构分析表明，胶体形成源自磷酸盐稳定的短程有序水铁矿相，其中磷酸盐通过共享角的 Fe-O-P 键抑制 Fe 聚合，并通过表面富集增强静电稳定性。天然有机物（NOM，2.5 和 10 mg C/L）可促进缺氧条件下胶体的生成，并通过静电和空间相互作用增强较高 Fe/P 比下的稳定性。测试的水基质中的稳定性评估显示出基质依赖性持久性，在没有 NOM 的情况下 28 天后，0–41% 的胶体保持悬浮状态，并且在 NOM 修正系统中胶体悬浮状态显着增强 (61–95%)。这项工作提供了对可能有助于氧化还原转变条件下磷迁移率的一个重要途径的机制见解。

articles.title: Mechanism of K63-linked polyubiquitin recognition and cleavage by the BRCA1-A complex
articles.abstract: Abstract Deubiquitylases modulate cellular processes by removing monoubiquitin or cleaving polyubiquitin chains. The ARISC–RAP80 complex partners with BRCA1–BARD1 to form the BRCA1-A supercomplex, which recognises K63-linked ubiquitin chains at DNA damage sites. ARISC–RAP80 contains multiple ubiquitin-binding sites, yet how these influence recognition and cleavage of K63-polyubiquitylated substrates remains unknown. We discover that a composite three-subunit interface allows ARISC–RAP80 to position K63-linked polyubiquitin chains in its catalytic site. Substrate recognition is further supported by RAP80 and non-catalytic ubiquitin-binding sites that impose a compact conformation on K63-polyubiquitylated substrates. This mechanism exploits the inherent flexibility of long ubiquitin chains and differs considerably from other deubiquitylases. Structure-guided mutageneses validate ubiquitin chain interactions, and cell-based assays demonstrate a functional role of the observed interfaces in chromatin recruitment. Our findings define mechanisms of polyubiquitin chain decoding and cleavage by ARISC–RAP80, linking ubiquitin reading and erasing functions to BRCA1-A mediated DNA damage responses.
articles.title_zh: BRCA1-A 复合物识别和切割 K63 连接的多聚泛素的机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 去泛素酶通过去除单泛素或裂解多泛素链来调节细胞过程。 ARISC-RAP80 复合体与 BRCA1-BARD1 结合形成 BRCA1-A 超级复合体，可识别 DNA 损伤位点处的 K63 连接泛素链。 ARISC–RAP80 包含多个泛素结合位点，但这些位点如何影响 K63 多泛素化底物的识别和切割仍然未知。我们发现复合三亚基界面允许 ARISC-RAP80 将 K63 连接的多聚泛素链定位在其催化位点。 RAP80 和非催化泛素结合位点进一步支持底物识别，这些位点在 K63 多泛素化底物上形成紧凑的构象。该机制利用长泛素链固有的灵活性，与其他去泛素化酶有很大不同。结构引导诱变验证了泛素链相互作用，基于细胞的测定证明了观察到的界面在染色质招募中的功能作用。我们的研究结果定义了 ARISC-RAP80 多聚泛素链解码和切割的机制，将泛素读取和擦除功能与 BRCA1-A 介导的 DNA 损伤反应联系起来。

articles.title: Disentangling surface and bulk properties of Ta3N5 photoanodes
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding how material and defect characteristics govern photoelectrochemical performance is essential for developing efficient and stable photoelectrodes. Although bulk properties are often emphasized, surfaces and interfaces can equally determine activity and stability under operation. Here, we use depth-sensitive characterization to disentangle surface and bulk properties of Ta 3 N 5 thin films. By preparing photoelectrodes from TaO x , TaN x , and Ta precursors, we systematically vary shallow and deep-level defect concentrations. Structural, compositional, and optoelectronic analyses show that the surfaces consistently exhibit oxygen enrichment, increased structural disorder, and higher deep-level defect densities than the bulk. However, the specific surface structure and its spatial extent depend strongly on precursor chemistry. Ta 3 N 5 derived from TaO x forms an extended, amorphous, oxide-rich surface with fewer deep-level defects, whereas TaN x and Ta-derived Ta 3 N 5 films exhibit thinner, more crystalline surfaces with increased mid-gap defect densities. A brief hydrofluoric acid treatment removes the disordered surface layer, improving crystallinity and hydrophilicity and enhancing photoelectrochemical performance and stability for ferrocyanide oxidation. These results highlight interfacial and defect engineering as routes toward durable, high-efficiency Ta 3 N 5 photoelectrodes.
articles.title_zh: 解开 Ta3N5 光阳极的表面和体特性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 了解材料和缺陷特性如何影响光电化学性能对于开发高效稳定的光电极至关重要。尽管经常强调体积特性，但表面和界面同样可以决定操作下的活性和稳定性。在这里，我们使用深度敏感表征来解开 Ta 3 N 5 薄膜的表面和体特性。通过用 TaO x 、TaN x 和 Ta 前驱体制备光电极，我们系统地改变浅层和深层缺陷浓度。结构、成分和光电分析表明，表面始终表现出比本体更高的氧富集、结构无序性增加和更高的深层缺陷密度。然而，特定的表面结构及其空间范围很大程度上取决于前体化学。源自TaO x 的Ta 3 N 5 形成延伸的、非晶的、富含氧化物的表面，具有较少的深能级缺陷，而TaN x 和Ta衍生的Ta 3 N 5 薄膜表现出更薄、更多的结晶表面，并且具有增加的中间带隙缺陷密度。短暂的氢氟酸处理可去除无序的表面层，提高结晶度和亲水性，并增强亚铁氰化物氧化的光电化学性能和稳定性。这些结果强调了界面和缺陷工程是实现耐用、高效 Ta 3 N 5 光电极的途径。

articles.title: Ultra-sensitive profiling of CRISPR-Cas off-target effects with Tracking-seq2
articles.abstract: Abstract Accurate detection of off-target activity in primary human cells is crucial for ensuring the safety of gene therapies, yet existing methods often lack sufficient sensitivity. To address this limitation, we develop Tracking-seq2, an advanced technology that integrates exogenous 5′ → 3′ exonuclease treatment and non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) pathway inhibitors with the original Tracking-seq. Tracking-seq2 exhibits enhanced sensitivity in profiling off-target sites of diverse genome editors—including Cas9, Cas12a, cytosine base editors (CBEs), adenine base editors (ABEs), and prime editors (PEs). Critically, Tracking-seq2 is directly applicable to clinically relevant primary human cell types, such as T cells and CD34 + hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). Furthermore, our findings reveal that genomic variations drive distinct off-target heterogeneity across different individuals, highlighting the necessity for personalized safety assessment in clinical genome editing applications. Tracking-seq2 provides a robust platform for sensitive off-target detection in primary cells, with sensitivity comparable to or exceeding current state-of-the-art methods.

articles.title: From helices to superhelices through hierarchical assembly across competing pathways
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding how molecular chirality propagates through competing self-assembly pathways remains a central challenge in supramolecular chemistry. We report a chiral π-conjugated quinquethiophene–rhodanine derivative forming four distinct and isolatable supramolecular aggregates from a single enantiomer under identical chemical conditions. These assemblies exhibit different chiroptical signatures, morphologies, hierarchical organization, and are selectively accessed through thermal and mechanical treatment. Calorimetry enables the experimental construction of the energy landscape, while long-term kinetic studies and spectral deconvolution reveal interconversions between helical structures, identifying an off-pathway hierarchical state. Remarkably, the most stable structure forms through a helix-to-superhelix transition governed by secondary nucleation. Cross-seeding experiments demonstrate that different dimensionality assemblies accelerate transformations across hierarchical levels, revealing an unusually interconnected assembly network. These results provide an experimental example where multiple supramolecular structures, their thermodynamic ordering, and kinetic connectivity are established within a single molecular system, showing how pathway selection programs chirality, hierarchy, and morphology in supramolecular materials.
articles.title_zh: 通过竞争途径的分层组装从螺旋到超螺旋

articles.title: Ultrashort-Chain Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances and Cholestasis: In Vitro Evidence of Liver Dysfunction from Emerging Environmental Contaminants
articles.abstract: Abstract Over the past 75 years, fluorinated contaminants present in aquatic, dietary, and environmental matrices have increasingly raised scientific and public health concerns. Among these substances, ultrashort perfluoroalkyl substances (US-PFAS) demonstrate substantial environmental persistence and mobility, comparable to that of their long-chain counterparts. Reported human serum concentrations of individual US-PFAS reach up to 27.7 ng/mL, substantially exceeding established thresholds for total PFAS levels. Nevertheless, data on human toxicity of US-PFAS remain limited. The present study aimed to investigate the impact of US-PFAS on cholestatic features and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms using an adverse outcome pathway network as a mechanistic compass. Human HepaRG liver cell cultures were exposed to 4 US-PFAS at various concentrations for 1 to 72 h. Transcriptomic profiles were assessed by RNA sequencing analysis. Functional alterations in early and key events associated with cholestatic pathology were evaluated using fluorescently labeled probes, while bile canaliculi dynamics were examined through in situ immunostaining and phase-contrast imaging. This revealed significant perturbations of molecular pathways involved in both early and late events relevant for cholestatic liver injury. US-PFAS did not significantly affect hepatocellular transporter activity or bile canalicular integrity at early time points (≤6 h). In contrast, prolonged exposure (24–72 h) to several US-PFAS elicited hepatocellular stress responses, such as oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress, and promoted inflammatory cell adhesion. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that US-PFAS have the capacity to affect biliary homeostasis and trigger downstream cholestatic events, providing mechanistic insight relevant for hazard identification.
articles.title_zh: 超短链 全氟烷基和多氟烷基物质 和胆汁淤积： 体外 肝功能障碍的证据 来自新兴环境污染物
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 在过去的 75 年里，水生、饮食和环境基质中存在的氟化污染物日益引起科学和公共卫生问题。在这些物质中，超短全氟烷基物质（US-PFAS）表现出与长链同类物质相当的显着环境持久性和流动性。据报道，个体 US-PFAS 的人血清浓度高达 27.7 ng/mL，大大超过了 PFAS 总水平的既定阈值。然而，有关 US-PFAS 的人体毒性的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在调查 US-PFAS 对胆汁淤积特征的影响，并使用不良结果途径网络作为机械指南针来阐明潜在机制。将人 HepaRG 肝细胞培养物暴露于不同浓度的 4 US-PFAS 中 1 至 72 小时。通过RNA测序分析评估转录组谱。使用荧光标记探针评估与胆汁淤积病理学相关的早期和关键事件的功能改变，同时通过原位免疫染色和相差成像检查胆小管动力学。这揭示了与胆汁淤积性肝损伤相关的早期和晚期事件中涉及的分子途径的显着扰动。 US-PFAS 在早期时间点（≤6 小时）不会显着影响肝细胞转运蛋白活性或胆管完整性。相反，长时间（24-72小时）接触几种US-PFAS会引发肝细胞应激反应，例如氧化应激和内质网应激，并促进炎症细胞粘附。总的来说，这些发现表明 US-PFAS 有能力影响胆汁稳态并触发下游胆汁淤积事件，为危险识别提供相关的机制见解。

articles.title:
Electrochemically
Driven Sorbent-Mediated Recovery
of CO2 in Marine Inorganic Carbon Extraction Processes
articles.abstract: Abstract The oceans act as a sink for atmospheric CO2, absorbing more than a quarter of global emissions annually. Technologies for marine inorganic carbon dioxide removal (mCDR) have recently gained attention as a means of leveraging this effect to reduce environmental CO2 concentrations. In pH-swing mCDR systems, electrochemical acidification drives the conversion of dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) in seawater to CO2, which is then removed through vacuum stripping before the water is realkalinized and released to the ocean to draw down atmospheric carbon. While most research has focused on the pH-swing process itself, little attention has been devoted to the stripping step, which is particularly capital- and energy-intensive and indiscriminately removes dissolved oxygen, which is vital to marine life. In this work, we present a framework for an alternative sorbent-mediated CO2 concentration process, analyzing and experimentally demonstrating an electrochemically mediated embodiment. A comparative energetic and technoeconomic assessment is presented, evaluating performance relative to state-of-the-art vacuum processes and indicating that a sorbent-mediated extraction process can be a viable alternative.
articles.title_zh:
电化学
驱动吸附剂介导的回收
海洋无机碳提取过程中二氧化碳的排放
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋是大气二氧化碳的汇，每年吸收全球排放量的四分之一以上。海洋无机二氧化碳去除（mCDR）技术最近作为利用这种效应降低环境二氧化碳浓度的一种手段而受到关注。在 pH 摆动 mCDR 系统中，电化学酸化驱动海水中溶解的无机碳 (DIC) 转化为 CO2，然后通过真空汽提将 CO2 去除，然后将水重新碱化并释放到海洋以吸收大气中的碳。虽然大多数研究都集中在 pH 值波动过程本身，但很少关注剥离步骤，该步骤尤其需要大量资金和能源，并且会不加区别地去除溶解氧，而溶解氧对海洋生物至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了替代吸附剂介导的二氧化碳浓缩过程的框架，分析并通过实验证明了电化学介导的实施方案。提出了比较能量和技术经济评估，评估了相对于最先进的真空工艺的性能，并表明吸附剂介导的萃取工艺可以是一种可行的替代方案。

articles.title:
Gamma-Irradiation-Enhanced
Reduction of 99Tc(VII) and Re(VII) by Natural Pyrite
articles.abstract: Abstract Reductive immobilization of 99Tc(VII) to sparingly soluble TcO2-type phases is a key process limiting 99Tc transport in the environment. However, the reactivity of natural pyrite toward 99Tc(VII) under conditions relevant to nuclear waste repositories remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the interactions of 99Tc(VII) and its nonradioactive congener Re(VII) with natural pyrite under γ-irradiation (0–100 kGy; 0–100 Gy/min). In the absence of γ-irradiation, natural pyrite exhibited limited reactivity toward 99Tc(VII) at circumneutral to alkaline pH over the investigated time scales. Under γ-irradiation, however, pyrite-mediated reductive sequestration of both Tc(VII) and Re(VII) was substantially enhanced, producing a TcO2/TcOx-TcSx mixture and ReO2 as dominant reduction products. Mechanistic analyses indicate that radiolytically generated hydrated electrons (eaq–) and hydrogen radicals (·H) directly reduce TcO4– and ReO4–, while pyrite and dissolved Fe2+ scavenge hydroxyl radicals (·OH) and sustain a reducing interfacial environment. Under acidic conditions, protonation of eaq– to ·H limits Tc(VII)/Re(VII) reduction efficiency. At higher pH, OH– suppresses intermediate disproportionation, promoting efficient stepwise reduction via consecutive one-electron transfer from eaq–. These findings demonstrate that γ-irradiation fundamentally alters the redox reactivity of natural pyrite and promotes radionuclide immobilization under nuclear waste repository conditions, providing critical constraints for predicting long-term radionuclide transport in deep geological disposal systems.
articles.title_zh:
伽马射线增强
天然黄铁矿还原 99Tc(VII) 和 Re(VII)
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 99Tc(VII) 还原固定到难溶的 TcO2 型相中是限制 99Tc 在环境中传输的关键过程。然而，在与核废料储存库相关的条件下，天然黄铁矿对 99Tc(VII) 的反应性仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们研究了 99Tc(VII) 及其非放射性同源物 Re(VII) 与天然黄铁矿在 γ 辐射（0–100 kGy；0–100 Gy/min）下的相互作用。在没有 γ 辐射的情况下，天然黄铁矿在所研究的时间范围内在中性至碱性 pH 值下对 99Tc(VII) 表现出有限的反应性。然而，在 γ 辐射下，黄铁矿介导的 Tc(VII) 和 Re(VII) 的还原封存显着增强，产生 TcO2/TcOx-TcSx 混合物和 ReO2 作为主要还原产物。机理分析表明，辐射分解产生的水合电子（eaq–）和氢自由基（·H）直接还原TcO4–和ReO4–，而黄铁矿和溶解的Fe2+清除羟基自由基（·OH）并维持还原界面环境。在酸性条件下，eaq– 质子化为·H 限制了 Tc(VII)/Re(VII) 还原效率。在较高的 pH 值下，OH– 抑制中间歧化，通过 eaq– 的连续单电子转移促进有效的逐步还原。这些发现表明，γ-辐照从根本上改变了天然黄铁矿的氧化还原反应性，并促进核废料储存库条件下放射性核素的固定，为预测深层地质处置系统中的长期放射性核素迁移提供了关键约束。

articles.title:
A Potential Difference-Driven
Cascade Effect of Cathode
Biofilm–Plant Physiology Governs the Efficiency-Energy-Risk
Trade-Off in Constructed Wetland–Microbial Electrolysis Cells
articles.abstract: Abstract Conventional potential difference optimization in microbial electrolysis cell-integrated constructed wetlands (ECWs) treating antibiotic-laden wastewater frequently prioritizes single-dimensional removal efficiency, critically overlooking trade-offs with energy consumption and ecological risks. By evaluating four ECWs operated under varying potential differences treating chloramphenicol (CAP) wastewater via physicochemical metrics, multiomics, structural equation modeling, and comprehensive risk assessment, we identified a potential difference-driven “cathode biofilm–plant physiology” cascade effect governing this “efficiency-energy-risk” trade-off. Specifically, moderate potential differences (0.5 and 0.8 V) achieved superior total nitrogen (79.5–80.1%) and substantial CAP (90.9–92.5%) removal, driven by the selectively enriched electroactive, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium and CAP-degrading bacteria (e.g., Geobacter sp., Ectobacillus sp., Defluviilinea sp016789025). These microbiomes provided continuous ammonium supply, activating diverse plant nitrogen pathways and stimulating robust root radial oxygen loss to engineer a microoxic-anoxic microenvironment for comprehensive risk mitigation. Concurrently, relative to the 0.2 V control group, the 0.5 V condition minimized greenhouse gas emissions (a 49.2% reduction), lowered effluent ecotoxicity by 47.4%, and suppressed AMR risk by 56.0%, without incurring excess energy input. Ultimately, the optimal 0.5 V potential difference establishes a sustainable efficiency-energy-risk equilibrium, empowering ECWs as robust biogeochemical barriers under a unified “One Health” perspective.
articles.title_zh:
势差驱动
阴极级联效应
生物膜-植物生理学控制效率-能源-风险
人工湿地与微生物电解池的权衡
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：微生物电解池集成人工湿地（ECW）处理富含抗生素的废水时，传统的电势差优化经常优先考虑单维去除效率，严重忽视了能源消耗和生态风险之间的权衡。通过物理化学指标、多组学、结构方程模型和综合风险评估评估在不同电位差下处理氯霉素（CAP）废水的四个 ECW，我们确定了电位差驱动的“阴极生物膜-植物生理学”级联效应，控制着这种“效率-能源-风险”的权衡。具体而言，在选择性富集的电活性、异化硝酸盐还原为铵和 CAP 降解细菌（例如，Geobacter sp.、Ectobacillus sp.、Defluviilinea sp016789025）的驱动下，中等电位差（0.5 和 0.8 V）实现了优异的总氮 (79.5–80.1%) 和大量 CAP (90.9–92.5%) 去除。这些微生物群提供持续的铵供应，激活不同的植物氮途径并刺激强劲的根部径向氧损失，以设计微氧-缺氧微环境以全面缓解风险。同时，相对于 0.2 V 对照组，0.5 V 条件最大限度地减少了温室气体排放（减少了 49.2%），将废水生态毒性降低了 47.4%，并将 AMR 风险抑制了 56.0%，且不会产生过多的能量输入。最终，最佳的 0.5 V 电位差建立了可持续的效率-能源-风险平衡，使 ECW 在统一的“One Health”视角下成为强大的生物地球化学屏障。

articles.title:
DURABLE: A Workflow
for Determining Corrosion-Driving
and Protective Microbial Mechanisms
articles.abstract: Abstract Microbiologically influenced corrosion (MIC) threatens global infrastructure, causing billions of dollars in annual losses. Its persistence stems from unresolved mechanisms─particularly the metabolites produced by microorganisms that drive or inhibit corrosion─and the microbial community structures. Progress has been hindered by the absence of systematic workflows to rapidly and accurately identify MIC-relevant microorganisms and their functions. Here, we present DURABLE (Detection of Unique Corrosion Resistant or Accelerating Biologics in a Laboratory Environment), a pipeline that couples high-throughput microbial screening with genomic and metabolic workflows. We applied the DURABLE workflow to six diesel tank samples and revealed fuel-dependent microbial community structures, which showed greater diversity and evenness in bacterial communities than their fungal counterparts. The workflow used carbon steel beads to rapidly screen over 80 bacterial isolates for corrosive activity, reducing assay time to approximately 2 days compared with the conventional 30-day metal coupon test. More than 40 isolates were identified as corrosive. Further testing using mass spectrometry analysis revealed corrosion-associated metabolites, which were further validated using electrochemical assays. Thus, DURABLE achieved a ∼15-fold increase in screening speed and provided a scalable and mechanistic framework for dissecting MIC dynamics. We expect this advance will enable the development of precision mitigation strategies in hydrocarbon fuel infrastructure.
articles.title_zh:
耐用：工作流程
用于确定腐蚀驱动
和保护性微生物机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微生物腐蚀 (MIC) 威胁着全球基础设施，每年造成数十亿美元的损失。其持久性源于尚未解决的机制（尤其是驱动或抑制腐蚀的微生物产生的代谢物）以及微生物群落结构。由于缺乏快速准确识别 MIC 相关微生物及其功能的系统工作流程，进展受到阻碍。在这里，我们推出了 DURABLE（在实验室环境中检测独特的耐腐蚀或加速生物制剂），这是一种将高通量微生物筛选与基因组和代谢工作流程结合起来的管道。我们将 DURABLE 工作流程应用于六个柴油箱样品，并揭示了依赖燃料的微生物群落结构，其细菌群落比真菌群落具有更大的多样性和均匀性。该工作流程使用碳钢珠快速筛选 80 多种细菌分离株的腐蚀性活性，与传统的 30 天金属挂片测试相比，将测定时间缩短至大约 2 天。超过 40 种菌株被鉴定为具有腐蚀性。使用质谱分析进行的进一步测试揭示了与腐蚀相关的代谢物，并使用电化学测定进一步验证了这些代谢物。因此，DURABLE 的筛选速度提高了约 15 倍，并为剖析 MIC 动态提供了可扩展的机械框架。我们预计这一进展将有助于在碳氢化合物燃料基础设施中制定精确的缓解策略。

articles.title:
Anomalies of Net
Primary Productivity under Compound
Marine Heatwaves and Microplastics
articles.abstract: Abstract Marine heatwaves (MHW) and microplastics (MPs) pollution increasingly co-occur, yet the response of phytoplankton net primary production (NPP) to this compound condition remains incompletely characterized, in part because analyses confined to local conditions may overlook nonlocal influences. Here we developed an adaptive machine learning framework to evaluate global NPP anomalies under co-occurring MHW and MPs. The results indicate that comparable compound-stress regimes corresponded to divergent NPP outcomes depending on regional nutrient backgrounds: an anomalous increase coincided with nitrate replenishment in oligotrophic waters, whereas an anomalous decrease coincided with silicate accumulation in iron-limited, diatom-dominated waters. Furthermore, pronounced NPP anomalies frequently exhibited a geographic offset from heatwave cores, a spatial mismatch consistent with a shock-transmission-spillover (STS) framework, here interpreted as a spatial teleconnection between the thermal forcing and the ecological response. Pending in situ validation, these observed associations indicate that monitoring confined to thermal or pollution sources may misplace ecological risk. Consequently, these findings support a shift toward downstream monitoring along current pathways relevant to fisheries and carbon uptake.
articles.title_zh:
网络异常
复合条件下的初级生产力
海洋热浪和微塑料
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋热浪（MHW）和微塑料（MP）污染日益同时发生，但浮游植物净初级生产力（NPP）对这种复合条件的响应仍未完全表征，部分原因是仅限于局部条件的分析可能会忽视非局部影响。在这里，我们开发了一个自适应机器学习框架来评估同时发生的 MHW 和 MP 下的全球 NPP 异常。结果表明，根据区域营养背景，可比较的复合胁迫状况对应于不同的NPP结果：异常增加与寡营养水域中硝酸盐的补充同时发生，而异常减少与铁有限、硅藻为主的水域中硅酸盐的积累同时发生。此外，明显的NPP异常经常表现出与热浪核心的地理偏移，这是一种与冲击-传递-溢出（STS）框架一致的空间失配，这里解释为热强迫与生态响应之间的空间遥相关。在现场验证之前，这些观察到的关联表明，仅限于热源或污染源的监测可能会错失生态风险。因此，这些发现支持沿着当前与渔业和碳吸收相关的途径转向下游监测。

articles.title:
Benchmark-Dose Modeling
Aligns Molecular Remodeling
with Neurofunctional Impairment in Imidaclothiz-Exposed Honey Bees
articles.abstract: Abstract Pollinator risk assessment for emerging neonicotinoids still relies heavily on lethality-oriented apical end points, which may miss the intake region in which sensory or behavioral impairment emerges without overt mortality. We asked whether imidaclothiz (IMT) produces neurofunctional impairment at realized intakes below those associated with reduced survival. Adult worker honey bees (Apis mellifera) were exposed to IMT for 10 days, and realized-intake dosimetry was combined with benchmark-dose (BMD) modeling for survival, electroantennography (EAG), proboscis extension reflex (PER), and untargeted head-tissue metabolomic end points. Across alternative lower-tail summaries, metabolomic BMDs extended below the Day-10 mortality BMD10 (≈0.107 μg bee–1 day–1) and overlapped with the lowest EAG and PER benchmarks. This cross-level alignment supports the interpretation that lower-tail molecular sensitivity summaries and selected neurofunctional benchmarks occupy an intake region that lethality-based end points alone do not resolve. Dose-responsive metabolomic features were tentatively assigned to tryptophan–kynurenine and glycerophospholipid/redox-related pathways; orthogonal protein measurements showed broad concordance with these metabolomic patterns. By placing molecular, neurofunctional, and apical responses on a common realized-intake scale, this cross-level BMD comparison approach supports characterization of sublethal neonicotinoid risk in pollinators.
articles.title_zh:
基准剂量建模
对齐分子重塑
暴露于咪唑啉的蜜蜂神经功能受损
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 对新兴新烟碱类杀虫剂的传粉媒介风险评估仍然严重依赖于以致死率为导向的顶端终点，这可能会错过出现感觉或行为损害但没有明显死亡的摄入区域。我们询问咪达氯噻嗪 (IMT) 在实际摄入量低于与生存率降低相关的摄入量时是否会产生神经功能损伤。成年工蜂 (Apis mellifera) 暴露于 IMT 10 天，并将实际摄入剂量测定与基准剂量 (BMD) 模型相结合，以求生存、触角电图 (EAG)、长鼻伸展反射 (PER) 和非目标头部组织代谢组学终点。在替代的下尾总结中，代谢组 BMD 延伸至低于第 10 天死亡率 BMD10（约 0.107 μg bee-1 day-1），并与最低的 EAG 和 PER 基准重叠。这种跨水平对齐支持这样的解释：下尾分子敏感性摘要和选定的神经功能基准占据了仅基于致死率的终点无法解决的摄入区域。剂量反应性代谢组学特征暂时归属于色氨酸-犬尿氨酸和甘油磷脂/氧化还原相关途径；正交蛋白质测量显示与这些代谢组模式广泛一致。通过将分子、神经功能和顶端反应置于共同的实际摄入量范围内，这种跨水平 BMD 比较方法支持对传粉昆虫亚致死新烟碱类风险的表征。

articles.title:
Where to Restore:
Hydrological Connectivity Differentiates
Ecological Restoration Outcomes in Dam-Regulated Rivers
articles.abstract: Abstract Ecological stabilization of sandbars is essential for maintaining habitat integrity in dam-regulated rivers, yet whether restoration effectiveness varies systematically within project areas and is predictable from design-phase hydrological data remains largely unexamined. Here, we show that hydrological connectivity gradients create divergent spatial patterns of restoration effectiveness, based on field campaigns of a sandbar stabilization project in the Middle Yangtze River. Vegetation established uniformly across the project area (coverage 83 ± 16%) was sharply differentiated within a single flood season along the connectivity gradient (postflood coverage 0–76%), with 65% of the project area covered by flood-deposited sediment. Two independent predictive methods converged on a primary flow-velocity threshold of 0.82 m/s, delineating an effective zone (33%; coverage 47%); descriptive clustering of the above-threshold plots further distinguished transitional (22%; coverage 7%) and limited (44%; coverage <1%) response groups. This spatial pattern persisted through the postflood monitoring period, indicating a connectivity-associated organization of vegetation-cover trajectories. Hydrological data available during project design can identify these spatial boundaries, enabling differentiated strategies that allocate resources where success is most likely. Coupling spatial connectivity criteria with established temporal thresholds, we propose a “when-and-where” framework as a transferable methodological approach for optimizing ecological restoration in dam-regulated rivers.
articles.title_zh:
恢复地点：
水文连通性差异化
大坝调节河流的生态恢复成果
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 沙洲的生态稳定对于维持大坝调节河流的栖息地完整性至关重要，但恢复效果是否在项目区域内系统性地变化以及是否可以根据设计阶段的水文数据进行预测，在很大程度上尚未得到检验。在这里，我们根据长江中游沙洲稳定项目的实地活动，表明水文连通性梯度会产生不同的恢复效果空间模式。整个项目区均匀建立的植被（覆盖度83±16%）在一个洪水季节内沿连通梯度（洪水后覆盖度0-76%）分化明显，65%的项目区被洪水沉积的沉积物覆盖。两种独立的预测方法收敛于 0.82 m/s 的主流速阈值，描绘出有效区域（33%；覆盖率 47%）；上述阈值图的描述性聚类进一步区分了过渡性（22%；覆盖率 7%）和有限（44%；覆盖率<1%）响应组。这种空间模式在洪水后监测期间持续存在，表明植被覆盖轨迹的连通性相关组织。项目设计期间可用的水文数据可以识别这些空间边界，从而实现差异化策略，将资源分配到最有可能成功的地方。将空间连通性标准与既定的时间阈值相结合，我们提出了一个“何时何地”框架，作为优化大坝调节河流生态恢复的可转移方法。

articles.title:
Correction
to “Disaster Preparedness and Perceptions
of People who Experienced Water Insecurity: Insights from the Lloyd’s
Register Foundation’s World Risk Poll”
articles.abstract: Abstract Water insecurity refers to lacking stable access to enough safe water for drinking and domestic use. To understand the communication needs of individuals who have experienced water insecurity, we analyzed World Risk Poll data from over 125,000 participants across 121 countries. We present three key findings. First, having experienced water insecurity was associated with lower perceived disaster preparedness. Second, participants who had experienced water insecurity trusted disaster information providers slightly less, though local media and emergency services were highly trusted. Third, worry about water safety was more strongly correlated with worry about severe weather than with worry about climate change, especially among individuals who had experienced water insecurity. Therefore, individuals who have experienced water insecurity may benefit from communications that improve disaster preparedness, leverage local media and emergency services, and emphasize threats of severe weather to water safety.
articles.title_zh:
修正
到“防灾准备和看法
经历过水不安全的人的比例：来自劳合社的见解
注册基金会的世界风险民意调查”
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 水不安全是指无法稳定获得足够的安全水用于饮用水和家庭用水。为了了解经历过水不安全的个人的沟通需求，我们分析了来自 121 个国家/地区超过 125,000 名参与者的世界风险民意调查数据。我们提出了三个主要发现。首先，经历过水不安全与较低的备灾意识有关。其次，经历过水不安全的参与者对灾害信息提供者的信任度稍低，尽管当地媒体和紧急服务机构高度信任。第三，对水安全的担忧与对恶劣天气的担忧比对气候变化的担忧更密切相关，特别是对于那些经历过水不安全的人来说。因此，经历过水不安全的个人可能会受益于改善备灾、利用当地媒体和应急服务以及强调恶劣天气对水安全的威胁的通信。

articles.title:
Rubber
Dams: An Overlooked Source of Leachable Organic
Contaminants within Water Infrastructure Systems
articles.abstract: Abstract Inflatable rubber dams are used globally within water infrastructure, yet their potential as chemical contaminant sources remains overlooked. We investigated the occurrence of rubber additives and their transformation products within rubber dam materials (RDMs), including their organic extracts, aqueous leachates, and adjacent receiving waters, by employing targeted quantitative analysis combined with high-resolution mass spectrometry-based suspect and nontargeted screening. Targeted analysis revealed that substituted para-phenylenediamines (PPDs), their quinone/nonquinone products, and other rubber additives were abundant in RDM extracts and leachates. The antiozonant product N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N′-phenyl- p-phenylenediamine quinone (6PPDQ) was detected in laboratory leachates and receiving water adjacent to an in-service dam at toxic concentrations. Suspect and nontargeted screening of the RDM extracts and leachates identified 83 potential RDM-derived contaminants, with 75 structurally annotated (confidence level ≥3), including various hexa-(methoxymethyl)melamine analogues and 4-hydroxydiphenylamine homologues. To assess environmental health impacts, in silico toxicity predictions on unmonitored compounds prioritized from suspect and nontarget screening indicated high ecotoxicity potential, including aquatic neurotoxicity, revealing critical toxicological data deficits for rubber-derived contaminants. These findings demonstrate that water infrastructure materials can act as point sources of 6PPDQ and other contaminants, highlighting critical gaps in infrastructure risk assessment and emphasizing the need for environmentally benign rubber materials.suspect and nontargeted screeningNTS
articles.title_zh:
橡胶
水坝：一个被忽视的可浸出有机物来源
水基础设施系统内的污染物
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 充气橡胶坝在全球范围内的水利基础设施中得到广泛应用，但其作为化学污染源的潜力仍然被忽视。我们通过采用针对性定量分析与基于高分辨率质谱的可疑和非靶向筛选相结合，研究了橡胶坝材料 (RDM) 中橡胶添加剂及其转化产物的出现情况，包括其有机提取物、水性渗滤液和邻近的接收水。针对性分析表明，RDM 提取物和浸出液中含有丰富的取代对苯二胺 (PPD)、其醌/非醌产品和其他橡胶添加剂。在实验室渗滤液和一座正在使用的大坝附近的接收水中检测到了有毒浓度的抗臭氧剂产品 N-(1,3-二甲基丁基)-N'-苯基-对苯二胺醌 (6PPDQ)。对 RDM 提取物和渗滤液进行可疑和非靶向筛选，鉴定出 83 种潜在的 RDM 衍生污染物，其中 75 种有结构注释（置信度≥3），包括各种六（甲氧基甲基）三聚氰胺类似物和 4-羟基二苯胺同系物。为了评估环境健康影响，对可疑和非目标筛选优先考虑的未监测化合物进行了计算机毒性预测，表明其具有很高的生态毒性潜力，包括水生神经毒性，揭示了橡胶衍生污染物的关键毒理学数据缺陷。这些发现表明，水基础设施材料可以作为 6PPDQ 和其他污染物的点源，凸显了基础设施风险评估中的关键差距，并强调了对环境友好型橡胶材料的需求。可疑和非针对性筛查NTS

articles.title:
A
Review: Mechanisms, Processes and Design Principles
of Recycling Spent Lithium-Ion Battery and Biomass
articles.abstract: Abstract End-of-life lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) and biomass wastes are usually studied in separate fields. This review shows that they should also be understood as complementary reaction systems. Biomass not only acts as a cheap carbon source but also provides reductive gases, biochar, organic acids, ligands, and redox-active organics to enable LIB recycling. Spent LIB-derived materials can serve as both a valuable resource and a catalyst to leverage biomass conversion. On this basis, this Review brings together three directions that are discussed in one framework: biomass-assisted thermochemical recycling, biomass-derived leaching systems, and LIB-enabled catalytic biomass valorization. This review identifies the common principles that control these processes, including oxygen potential, phase evolution, kinetics, coupled acid–redox–coordination chemistry, and catalyst design. We further compare process configurations, product pathways, and environmental trade-offs. Future work should focus on resolving coupled reaction mechanisms, defining composition and reactor design windows, integrating process-level assessment, and enabling data-driven optimization for scalable and low-impact corecycling systems.
articles.title_zh:
一个
回顾：机制、流程和设计原则
废旧锂离子电池和生物质的回收利用
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 报废锂离子电池（LIB）和生物质废物通常在不同的领域进行研究。本综述表明，它们也应该被理解为互补反应系统。生物质不仅可以作为廉价的碳源，还可以提供还原性气体、生物炭、有机酸、配体和氧化还原活性有机物，以实现锂离子电池的回收。废锂离子电池衍生材料既可以作为宝贵的资源，也可以作为利用生物质转化的催化剂。在此基础上，本综述汇集了在一个框架中讨论的三个方向：生物质辅助热化学回收、生物质衍生浸出系统和LIB催化生物质增值。本综述确定了控制这些过程的共同原理，包括氧势、相演化、动力学、耦合酸-氧化还原-配位化学和催化剂设计。我们进一步比较工艺配置、产品途径和环境权衡。未来的工作应侧重于解决耦合反应机制、定义成分和反应器设计窗口、集成过程级评估以及为可扩展和低影响的核心循环系统实现数据驱动的优化。

articles.title: Production, Biodegradation, and Recalcitrance of Organic Carbon from Cultivated Saccharina latissima in Norway
articles.abstract: Abstract Particulate (POC) and dissolved (DOC) organic carbon released during macroalgae cultivation has been shown to lead to carbon burial and export to the open ocean and deep sea. The recalcitrant portion of the DOC (RDOC) is a critical contributor to carbon sequestration and a major knowledge gap. We investigate the production and bioavailability of DOC released from Saccharina latissima, a primary cultivar in Europe, with a focus on RDOC quantification. DOC release rates were 0.5–1.4 mg C g(dw)−1 h–1 within 24 h, and concentrations stabilized after 187 days of biodegradation, at 37–79% (mean 58%) from initial levels. The kelp released 920 (17%) unique compounds, including large quantities of sulfur-containing molecules (CHOS, CHONS). Increasing recalcitrance was observed in kelp and control treatments, despite small variations in CRAM molecules. Microbial biodegradation generated 1,805 (34%) new molecules, including 1,207 in the recalcitrant DOM fraction. Island of Stability (IOS) analysis revealed an intensity-weighted abundance of 0.2% RDOC in kelp treatments, with persistence on geological time scales. Beyond its biomass applications, macroalgae cultivation enables scalable CO2 sequestration in the oceans through RDOC production from continuous release and degradation of DOC and POC during grow-out, in itself a value-added product.
articles.title_zh: 生产、生物降解、 和有机的顽抗 来自耕种的碳 阔糖 在挪威
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 大型藻类培养过程中释放的颗粒（POC）和溶解（DOC）有机碳已被证明会导致碳埋藏并输出到公海和深海。 DOC（RDOC）的顽固部分是碳封存的关键因素，也是主要的知识差距。我们研究了欧洲主要品种 Saccharina latissima 释放的 DOC 的生产和生物利用度，重点是 RDOC 定量。 24小时内DOC释放率为0.5–1.4 mg C g(dw)−1 h–1，生物降解187天后浓度稳定在初始水平的37–79%（平均58%）。海带释放出 920 种（17%）独特化合物，其中包括大量含硫分子（CHOS、CHONS）。尽管 CRAM 分子变化很小，但在海带和对照处理中观察到顽抗性增加。微生物生物降解产生了 1,805 个（34%）新分子，其中 1,207 个是顽固的 DOM 部分。稳定岛 (IOS) 分析显示，海带处理中的强度加权丰度为 0.2% RDOC，并且在地质时间尺度上具有持续性。除了生物质应用之外，大型藻类培养还可以通过在养成过程中不断释放和降解 DOC 和 POC 来生产 RDOC，从而在海洋中实现可扩展的二氧化碳封存，这本身就是一种增值产品。

articles.title:
Interpretable Graph
Deep Learning Reveals Ecological
Risks and Attribution Patterns of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons
in Urban Greenspace Soils across China
articles.abstract: Abstract Characterizing the complex environmental and socioeconomic associations underlying risks related to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in urban greenspace soils is important for ecosystem health, yet conventional tabular models do not explicitly represent these cross-domain dependencies. In this study, we present an interpretable heterogeneous graph attention network (Hetero-GAT) framework for PAH-related risk assessment in urban greenspace soils across China. By integrating SHapley additive explanations (SHAP) with attention-derived graph salience, our dual-perspective framework reveals clear heterogeneity in model-derived PAH risk attribution patterns. Geographical and meteorological variables form recurrent background attribution signals across the five risk end points, whereas energy, infrastructure, and traffic/logistics variables contribute more selectively to end point-specific patterns. Under grouped validation and unified benchmarking, Hetero-GAT achieved the highest mean overall predictive performance, although its numerical advantage over GCN was modest, indicating that its principal value lies in structured representation and attribution rather than predictive superiority alone. Furthermore, a city-level typology analysis, based on the aggregation of sample-level observations before clustering, identifies three urban structural profiles with distinct risk stratifications and attribution patterns. Mixed-profile and logistics/service-dominated cities exhibit higher risk distributions than infrastructure-provision-dominated cities, with the logistics/service-dominated group showing the highest median values across all five end points. These findings indicate that interpretable graph modeling can complement concentration-based monitoring with risk-oriented contextual information and support differentiated risk screening across urban structural profiles.
articles.title_zh:
可解释的图表
深度学习揭示生态学
多环芳烃的风险和归因模式
中国城市绿地土壤
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 表征城市绿地土壤中与多环芳烃 (PAH) 相关风险的复杂环境和社会经济关联对于生态系统健康非常重要，但传统的表格模型并未明确表示这些跨领域依赖性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个可解释的异质图注意网络（Hetero-GAT）框架，用于中国城市绿地土壤中与多环芳烃相关的风险评估。通过将 SHapley 附加解释 (SHAP) 与注意力衍生图显着性相结合，我们的双视角框架揭示了模型衍生的 PAH 风险归因模式的明显异质性。地理和气象变量在五个风险终点形成周期性背景归因信号，而能源、基础设施和交通/物流变量更有选择性地对特定终点模式做出贡献。在分组验证和统一基准测试下，Hetero-GAT 实现了最高的平均总体预测性能，尽管其相对于 GCN 的数值优势不大，这表明其主要价值在于结构化表示和归因，而不仅仅是预测优势。此外，城市级类型学分析基于聚类前样本级观察的聚合，确定了具有不同风险分层和归因模式的三种城市结构概况。混合型城市和物流/服务主导的城市比基础设施供应主导的城市表现出更高的风险分布，其中物流/服务主导的城市在所有五个端点中显示出最高的中值。这些发现表明，可解释的图形模型可以用风险导向的背景信息补充基于浓度的监测，并支持跨城市结构概况的差异化风险筛查。

articles.title:
Beyond
Total PFAS: Isomer Composition Matters for
Water Quality and Human Exposure Studies
articles.abstract: Abstract Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) produced by electrochemical fluorination are complex mixtures of linear and branched isomers that differ in physicochemical properties, environmental fate, bioaccumulation potential, and biological activity. Increasing evidence shows that not only linear but also branched PFAS isomers are prevalent in the environment. Yet, current monitoring frameworks and regulatory approaches largely rely on total PFAS isomer metrics, masking the distinct behaviors and toxicities of individual isomers and introducing uncertainty into exposure and risk assessments. In this Perspective, we examine the current knowledge of (1) the distribution and accumulation of PFAS isomers across environmental compartments, (2) analytical challenges associated with isomer separation, identification, and reporting, and (3) critical gaps in understanding the environmental and biological processes governing isomer-specific toxicity and fate. We argue that reliance on the sum of PFAS isomers rather than individual isomers may bias PFAS quantification, weaken exposure-response assessments, and limit the development of scientifically robust, isomer-informed risk assessment and regulation. Advancing PFAS risk evaluation will require a shift from aggregate measurements to isomer-resolved science and policy. To support this shift, we propose integrating advanced analytical techniques with in silico, in vivo, in vitro, and biomonitoring approaches to better characterize isomer-specific exposure, fate, and toxicity. Such efforts will improve risk characterization and provide a stronger scientific foundation for regulatory frameworks that more accurately reflect real-world PFAS exposures and better protect environmental and human health.
articles.title_zh:
超越
PFAS 总量：异构体成分对
水质和人体接触研究
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 电化学氟化产生的全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 是直链和支链异构体的复杂混合物，其物理化学性质、环境归趋、生物蓄积潜力和生物活性各不相同。越来越多的证据表明，环境中不仅普遍存在直链 PFAS 异构体，而且还普遍存在支链 PFAS 异构体。然而，当前的监测框架和监管方法在很大程度上依赖于总 PFAS 异构体指标，掩盖了单个异构体的独特行为和毒性，并给暴露和风险评估带来了不确定性。在本视角中，我们研究了以下方面的当前知识：(1) PFAS 异构体在环境区划中的分布和积累，(2) 与异构体分离、识别和报告相关的分析挑战，以及 (3) 在了解控制异构体特异性毒性和命运的环境和生物过程方面的关键差距。我们认为，依赖 PFAS 异构体的总和而不是单个异构体可能会使 PFAS 定量产生偏差，削弱暴露-反应评估，并限制科学稳健、基于异构体的风险评估和监管的发展。推进 PFAS 风险评估需要从总体测量转向异构体解析的科学和政策。为了支持这一转变，我们建议将先进的分析技术与计算机、体内、体外和生物监测方法相结合，以更好地表征异构体特异性暴露、命运和毒性。这些努力将改善风险特征，并为监管框架提供更坚实的科学基础，更准确地反映现实世界的 PFAS 暴露情况，更好地保护环境和人类健康。

articles.title:
Chlorination
Enhances Bacterial Invasion and Conjugative
Transfer of Antibiotic Resistance Genes in Biofilms
articles.abstract: Abstract Biofilms are widespread in water distribution systems and consist of bacterial cells with extensive cell-to-cell contact, a prerequisite for plasmid-mediated conjugative transfer of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). Although plasmid-mediated conjugative ARG transfer has been extensively studied, our understanding of how conjugation occurs within spatially structured bacterial biofilms and how chlorine disinfection influences the conjugation process remains limited. This study systematically investigated the effects of chlorine exposure on biofilm disruption, resistant bacteria invasion, and the conjugative transfer of ARGs in both monoculture and multispecies biofilms composed of Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas putida, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Results showed that free chlorine significantly enhanced plasmid-mediated ARG transfer in biofilms at an initial dose of 5 mgCl/L. This could be due to the disruption of recipient biofilm structure, which facilitated donor colonization of the biofilms and close contact with the recipient bacteria. The hotspots for ARG conjugative transfer in the biofilms shifted from the surface (18 ± 2 μm) to the inner layer (27 ± 3 μm) under free chlorine exposure in the multispecies biofilm model. Moreover, a mathematical model was developed to simulate the long-term dynamics of gene transfer within biofilms under free chlorine exposure. The simulation results indicated that exposure to 5 mgCl/L promoted deeper colonization of donor cells and enhanced the dissemination of ARGs throughout the biofilm. Collectively, our findings provide a mechanistic link between biofilm structural disruption, bacterial invasion, and accelerated ARG horizontal transfer in biofilms under free chlorine exposure.
articles.title_zh:
氯化
增强细菌侵袭和结合
生物膜中抗生素抗性基因的转移
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物膜广泛存在于配水系统中，由具有广泛细胞间接触的细菌细胞组成，这是质粒介导的抗生素抗性基因（ARG）接合转移的先决条件。尽管质粒介导的接合 ARG 转移已被广泛研究，但我们对接合如何在空间结构的细菌生物膜内发生以及氯消毒如何影响接合过程的理解仍然有限。本研究系统地研究了氯暴露对由大肠杆菌、恶臭假单胞菌和铜绿假单胞菌组成的单一培养物和多物种生物膜中生物膜破坏、耐药细菌入侵和 ARG 接合转移的影响。结果表明，初始剂量为 5 mgCl/L 的游离氯显着增强了生物膜中质粒介导的 ARG 转移。这可能是由于受体生物膜结构被破坏，从而促进了供体生物膜的定植以及与受体细菌的密切接触。在多物种生物膜模型中，游离氯暴露下，生物膜中 ARG 接合转移的热点从表面 (18 ± 2 μm) 转移到内层 (27 ± 3 μm)。此外，还开发了一个数学模型来模拟游离氯暴露下生物膜内基因转移的长期动态。模拟结果表明，暴露于 5 mgCl/L 促进了供体细胞的更深定植，并增强了 ARG 在整个生物膜中的传播。总的来说，我们的研究结果提供了游离氯暴露下生物膜结构破坏、细菌入侵和生物膜中 ARG 水平转移加速之间的机制联系。
